sources: Juice Shop data/static/challenges.yml (names, hints), vuln-code-snippet vuln-line markers, the challenge checks in routes/*.ts, and code read by hand at the pinned commit (2026-10-08); HANDOFF answer-key tables (SQLi session 3, XSS session 4, crypto + async session 7); severity rules in DESIGN.md and the user's recorded decisions. Leaked API Key has no site in the repo (the key is only in its own check in routes/verify.ts). Juice Shop's 23 seed passwords in data/static/users.yml stay unkeyed (user decision 2026-10-07).
